map.特征缩放 Min-Max适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Min-Max Feature Scaling best for?
map.x′ = (x − min)/(max − min)；[-1,1] 映射 x″: x' = (x - min)/(max - min); [-1,1] map x'' = 2x' - 1; Z-score approx (x - x_bar)/((max - min)/2)
map.Min-Max 把特征线性压到固定区间，保留原始分布形状但不改变相对关系；缺点是: Min-Max linearly compresses features into a fixed range, preserving shape but not relative relations; the downside is domination by outliers (one huge value squeezes the rest into a narrow band). Tree models need no scaling, while gradient-descent and distance-based models usually must do it.
map.注意 max 不能等于 min。: Note max must not equal min.
map.要求 max≠min，否则分母为零；异常值会压缩正常样本区间。: Requires max!=min, else division by zero; outliers compress the normal-sample range.
map.缩放到固定区间利于梯度下降与距离类算法(如 KNN、K-Means)收敛。: Scaling to a fixed range helps gradient descent and distance-based algorithms (e.g. KNN, K-Means) converge.

map.Min-Max 和 StandardScaler 怎么选？: How to choose between Min-Max and StandardScaler?
map.Min-Max 固定边界、对异常值敏感，适合已知范围(如图像 0~255)；St: Min-Max has fixed bounds and is outlier-sensitive, suited to known ranges (e.g. images 0-255); StandardScaler (mean 0, variance 1) is more robust to outliers, suited to most modeling.
map.测试集怎么缩放？: How to scale the test set?
map.必须用训练集的 min/max 缩放测试集，不能用测试集自身统计量，否则引入数据: Scale the test set with the training set's min/max, never the test set's own statistics, or you introduce data leakage and overstate generalization.
